projects.title: Build & Defend Your Home SOC
projects.description: Set up a fully functional mini-SOC using VirtualBox, Splunk, and Sysmon. Simulate attacks, detect them, and document your findings.

projects.title: Phishing to Domain Admin: Incident Response Simulation

projects.title: Hunting APT29: Detection Gap Analysis & Threat Hunt
